patch.value: The coverage gate every contributor is told to run is not a gate: run-tests.mjs coverage prints the shortfall and exits 0, so only CI can fail on coverage

The documented local coverage command exits non-zero on the same condition the hosted threshold step rejects; The failure message names the files below threshold and their uncovered lines, so a contributor can act without opening a CI log; The threshold values have a single declared source shared by the local command and the hosted step, rather than being restated in each; A negative control proves the local command can fail on a deliberately uncovered branch
The command AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md name as the coverage gate fails locally on exactly the condition the hosted global-threshold step fails on.

node scripts/run-tests.mjs coverage passes --coverage to vitest and nothing else. On 2026-08-05 it printed 'All files | 100 | 99.99 | 100 | 100' and exited 0. The hosted Gates (coverage) job then failed its separate 'Merge coverage and enforce global thresholds' step on the identical number: 'ERROR: Coverage for branches (99.99%) does not meet global threshold (100%)'. The shortfall was three unreachable nullish fallbacks in one file at 98.5 percent branches.
